$schema_note: Reusable node component templates. Each component is a partial Lucid shape definition with type, recommended dimensions, and style baked in. To use a component, copy its 'template' field, fill in id/text/boundingBox.x/y, and add to the shapes array of your diagram.
$how_to_use: Pick the component that matches the node's semantic role (terminator, process, decision, etc.). Copy the template. Set a unique 'id', the displayed 'text', and the boundingBox 'x' and 'y'. The 'w' and 'h' are pre-filled with recommended dimensions but can be overridden.

$dimension_rules.decision: MINIMUM 280w x 140h. Narrower diamonds force text to rotate vertically.
$dimension_rules.process: Typically 200-320w x 80-110h. Increase width for longer text.
$dimension_rules.warning_callout: Match neighbor heights, typically 200-240w x 100-240h depending on text length.

terminator_start_end.purpose: Workflow start, end, IN handoff, OUT handoff. Yellow oval.

terminator_success_end.purpose: Successful workflow completion. Green oval. Distinguishes positive end-states from generic IN/OUT.

process.purpose: Standard process step or matching action. Blue rectangle.

system_action.purpose: System or API call, webhook, event fire, AI action. Indigo rectangle.

decision.purpose: Branching decision. Yellow diamond. MUST be 280w x 140h minimum.

database_write.purpose: Database or CRM record create / update / delete. Magenta rectangle.

out_of_scope.purpose: Excluded population or out-of-scope branch shown for context. Red rectangle.

warning_callout.purpose: Bug, gap, or risk callout. Red rectangle. Text begins with WARNING: or BUG:.

sub_process_link.purpose: Link to a separate sub-process map. Purple rectangle. Width 3 stroke.

cross_system_handoff.purpose: Emphasize a handoff between systems. Dashed.

bug_risk_link.purpose: Link a warning_callout to its affected node. Red dashed, no arrowhead.

auto_convert_implicit.purpose: Implicit chain or auto-convert relationship. Lighter to indicate the user does not trigger this.

$endpoint_positioning_note: Connectors prefer auto-attached endpoints (NO 'position' property on either endpoint). If you DO need to specify position, you MUST specify it on BOTH endpoints (the Lucid spec rejects partial-position lines). Use position: {x: 0, y: 0.5} for left edge, {x: 1, y: 0.5} for right, {x: 0.5, y: 0} for top, {x: 0.5, y: 1} for bottom. Avoid the default {0.5, 0.5} which causes lines to overlap shape text.
